errors.text: The proposed graph-neural-network property predictor is not the target intervention of an MTP liquid-phase interatomic potential coupled to free-energy perturbation.
The mechanism omits free-energy perturbation, rapid convergence from low MTP–DFT energy-difference variance, electronic Gibbs-energy effects, and solid-state short-range-order stabilization.

The cited evidence concerns empirical EAM/Lennard-Jones simulations and alloy ordering; it does not demonstrate graph-neural-network prediction of melting properties or improved accuracy and efficiency.
No quantitative predictions corresponding to the target accuracy, speedup, or melting-temperature shifts are provided.
